programme.title: Hooked on Travel
programme.desc: Unspoiled coastline is what causes an angler to travel far and wide, and if one follows the Eastern shoreline of South Africa, you'd find areas that would draw any game fisher to the water. Tommo and Wes cover a lot of ground to discover the real wild coast.

programme.title: Reel Africa
programme.desc: The Majesty of the Mighty Zambezi River is on full display as we target the trophy Tiger and Bream species on offer at the Barotse Flood Plains.

programme.title: Inside Angling
programme.desc: We explore the remote windswept region of Southern Angola hunting for Kob, Garrick and Shad. The crew is joined by a Professor of Marine Biology who shares what he has learned about coastal fish migratory patterns and chalking up some amazing desert discoveries along the way.

programme.title: Wildfly
programme.desc: The Maldives has a reputation as an idyllic holiday destination, and this spectacular resort exemplifies that.
